tool_args.rationale: The prior model was refuted on confirmation, and the subsequent Hill-model attempt failed due to an implementation error rather than scientific evidence. Available authorized mechanism notes support a barrier-activated flux with sink inhibition and a square-root branch; fit all four parameters numerically to the seven available rows and allow the required fresh confirmation to assess tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its wide sink-gradient rows refute the previously attempted square-root-only siphon fit.
The observations are at a single horizon and do not point to a temporal ODE; a costly trajectory batch is not currently relevant.

considered_alternatives.option: cooperative Hill-2 sink inhibition with linear bleed
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: A plausible static alternative, but the previous attempt did not execute due to a missing fitted-parameter binding. The barrier-modulated siphon is a directly documented mechanism that includes both sink inhibition and the observed positive branch.
Nuisance measurements do not resolve the systematic gradient-dependent response.
